description_en: Queries the origin server protection configurations for a site, including the origin server protection switch, the back-to-origin convergence switch, and whether the back-to-origin IP addresses whitelist needs to be updated. It also provides detailed information about the back-to-origin IP addresses whitelist, including the current whitelist used by the site, the latest whitelist, and the differences between them
description_zh: 查询站点源站防护相关配置，包括源站防护开关、回源收敛开关、是否需要更新回源IP白名单，以及回源IP白名单相关详细信息，包括现在站点所使用的回源IP白名单、最新的回源IP白名单以及两者之间的差异
name: GetOriginProtection

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the ID

NeedUpdate.description_en:
Specifies whether the back-to-origin IP addresses whitelist needs to be updated. If the back-to-origin IP addresses whitelist in use differs from the latest back-to-origin IP addresses whitelist, it must be updated and this parameter returns true. Valid values:
true: Needs to be updated.
false: Does not need to be updated
NeedUpdate.description_zh:
回源IP白名单是否需要更新，当所使用的回源IP白名单和最新的回源IP白名单有差异时，就需要更新，此值返回true。

true：需要更新。
false：不需要更新
